definitions.D: Explicit rival completion, development, financing, survival, or estate-denial consideration.
definitions.C: Explicit own price, liquidity, affordability, reserve or financing consideration.
definitions.R: Explicit retention of own holdings/income or own portfolio priority beyond a bare decline.
definitions.T: Explicit timing disadvantage or a stated future condition for reconsideration.
definitions.F: Speaker's claimed buyer/seller role contradicts the recorded offer and current holdings.
definitions.N: No applicable explicit consideration in the two observed fields.

population: All acceptance-legal recipient-completing offers followed by direct reject_trade
exposure_limit: Initial schema inspection accidentally exposed existing aggregate counts and first row codes, plus a fragment of the second row. All later reading used masked rows. This is not a fully blinded review.
scope: Complete applied public/private fields; recorded reasons, not latent motives or verified reasoning.
